about: What the workflow needs from any issue tracker (docs/engineering/agent-workflow.md §3). Tracker-neutral: each tracker's skill under .agents/skills/tracker-<name>/ reads this file and sets a workspace up to match. Change the hand-offs here and in that section together.

states.name: Todo
states.means: Not started. An unassigned ticket is incoming and belongs to the designer.

states.name: In Progress
states.means: Its assignee is writing: specs, a design, code, fixes.

states.name: In Review
states.means: A pull request is open and waits for its assignee: a review, the owner's decision, an approval, the merge.

labels.name: escaped
labels.description: A bug found after a merge (a revert or a fix-forward). Note which review layer should have caught it; the case joins the reviewer's eval set.

label_groups.name: ask
label_groups.description: What the ticket's assignee is asked to do. Exactly one per ticket, replaced at every hand-off; the hand-off comment starts with the same word.

labels.name: specs-needed
labels.description: Write the specs for this work package: it has no approved scenarios yet.

labels.name: spec-changes-requested
labels.description: Change the specs as the review asks.

labels.name: spec-approved
labels.description: The specs are approved: merge the spec pull request.

labels.name: ready-to-implement
labels.description: Implement: the specs are on main, or no spec change is needed.

labels.name: code-changes-requested
labels.description: Fix or answer the review's findings.

labels.name: needs-architect
labels.description: Three review rounds without approval: arbitrate.

labels.name: needs-human
labels.description: The owner is asked to decide: a high-risk change, a design, another direction, a spec acceptance, a question.

labels.name: owner-approved
labels.description: The owner approved in the tracker: give the approval on GitHub.
